title: Whop, which helps people start, run, and scale businesses and uses AI to suggest business decisions, raised $205M led by Sequoia Capital at a $5.1B valuation (Natasha Mascarenhas/Bloomberg)
summary:
Natasha Mascarenhas / Bloomberg:
Whop, which helps people start, run, and scale businesses and uses AI to suggest business decisions, raised $205M led by Sequoia Capital at a $5.1B valuation  —  “Rule one of making money is go where they ain't.”  That's how famed investor Doug Leone, who used to run venture firm Sequoia Capital …

title: OpenAI says the PHP flaws, found using GPT-5.6 Sol, "are among several significant vulnerabilities" it found and expects "similar findings to increase sharply" (OpenAI)
summary:
OpenAI:
OpenAI says the PHP flaws, found using GPT-5.6 Sol, “are among several significant vulnerabilities” it found and expects “similar findings to increase sharply”  —  - Validate and fix the upstream vulnerability. … - Give affected organizations time to act.

title: Mach9, which develops AI-powered CAD software trained on proprietary, in-house AI models using multimodal image and laser scan datasets, raised a $34M Series A (Sean O'Kane/TechCrunch)
summary:
Sean O'Kane / TechCrunch:
Mach9, which develops AI-powered CAD software trained on proprietary, in-house AI models using multimodal image and laser scan datasets, raised a $34M Series A  —  When Alex Baikovitz co-founded Mach9 Robotics in 2021, his goal was to build a better, faster, and cheaper way for civil engineers to do visual inspections.

title: Cloudflare says it deployed WAF mitigations for all free and paid tier customers to combat two PHP flaws by default, about nine hours ahead of public disclosure (Cloudflare)
summary:
Cloudflare:
Cloudflare says it deployed WAF mitigations for all free and paid tier customers to combat two PHP flaws by default, about nine hours ahead of public disclosure  —  Today, Calif.io, Wiz, OpenAI and Quarkslab disclosed two vulnerabilities in PHP, tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 and known as php2shell.

title: Claude flagged 493 security issues across 25 open-source projects, covering 5M+ lines of C, C++, Java, PHP, and Python code; one went unnoticed for 21 years (Chris Rohlf/Anthropic)
summary:
Chris Rohlf / Anthropic:
Claude flagged 493 security issues across 25 open-source projects, covering 5M+ lines of C, C++, Java, PHP, and Python code; one went unnoticed for 21 years  —  Over the past year, we've published lots of data that shows that frontier AI models are more than capable of discovering and exploiting security vulnerabilities.

title: PHP's creators disclose a critical memory-management vulnerability, dubbed "PHP2Shell", that affects up to 70% of websites, discovered via GPT-5.6 Sol in August (Robert McMillan/Wall Street Journal)
summary:
Robert McMillan / Wall Street Journal:
PHP's creators disclose a critical memory-management vulnerability, dubbed “PHP2Shell”, that affects up to 70% of websites, discovered via GPT-5.6 Sol in August  —  AI tools helped find one of the most severe online bugs ever.  Cyber experts are racing to patch it before hackers use AI to exploit it.

title: PHP releases security fixes for two critical unauthenticated RCE vulnerabilities, affecting all web request-serving installations, and urges PHP users to update (PHP)
summary:
PHP:
PHP releases security fixes for two critical unauthenticated RCE vulnerabilities, affecting all web request-serving installations, and urges PHP users to update  —  PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 fix two critical vulnerabilities that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution.

title: ServiceNow and Nvidia launch Arc, a personal, long-running enterprise AI agent for productivity tasks across email and Teams, for RTX Spark and Nvidia OpenShell (Radhika Rajkumar/ZDNET)
summary:
Radhika Rajkumar / ZDNET:
ServiceNow and Nvidia launch Arc, a personal, long-running enterprise AI agent for productivity tasks across email and Teams, for RTX Spark and Nvidia OpenShell  —  The two companies are trying to solve the AI agent security conundrum with multiple layers of real-time security checks.

title: Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation, up from $5.55B after raising a $550M Series D in March (Rosie Harris-Davison/City A.M.)
summary:
Rosie Harris-Davison / City A.M.:
Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised a $550M Series E at an $8.8B post-money valuation, up from $5.55B after raising a $550M Series D in March  —  Legal tech firm Legora has raised $550m (£410m) in Series E funding as it expands its footprint in the US, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to 26 additional countries, taking the total to 83 countries, and says the platform's advertiser base is 100K+, up from 20K in August (Alix Coutures/The Information)
summary:
Alix Coutures / The Information:
OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to 26 additional countries, taking the total to 83 countries, and says the platform's advertiser base is 100K+, up from 20K in August  —  OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT ads to 26 more countries as it tries to turn advertising into a bigger source of revenue to help cover its AI costs.

title: Apple says it plans to add Reachability to the iPhone Duo later in 2026, helping users with small hands more easily access the left or right edges of the screen (Julian Chokkattu/Wired)
summary:
Julian Chokkattu / Wired:
Apple says it plans to add Reachability to the iPhone Duo later in 2026, helping users with small hands more easily access the left or right edges of the screen  —  Apple made an astonishingly good first foldable.  Now iOS and third-party apps need time to catch up.  —  Rating:

title: Spotify launches its first standalone, native in-car app built on Android Automotive OS, debuting on select Audi models, with a custom UI controlled by Spotify (Andrew J. Hawkins/The Verge)
summary:
Andrew J. Hawkins / The Verge:
Spotify launches its first standalone, native in-car app built on Android Automotive OS, debuting on select Audi models, with a custom UI controlled by Spotify  —  Say goodbye to those aux cables.  Spotify's new in-car app is here, and it's rolling out to Audi vehicles today.

title: Nvidia launches its OpenShell Reference Architecture, a framework to secure, monitor, and govern AI agents, and partners with Canonical, AWS, BBVA, and others (Thomas Claburn/The Register)
summary:
Thomas Claburn / The Register:
Nvidia launches its OpenShell Reference Architecture, a framework to secure, monitor, and govern AI agents, and partners with Canonical, AWS, BBVA, and others  —  Nvidia has proposed a new way to keep corporate AI agents in line.  —  Nvidia on Wednesday introduced its OpenShell Reference Architecture.

title: GTC Berlin: Jensen Huang pushes Europe on AI adoption, saying "for Europe to benefit from AI ... you need all the end markets, the end industries to adopt AI" (Bloomberg)
summary:
Bloomberg:
GTC Berlin: Jensen Huang pushes Europe on AI adoption, saying “for Europe to benefit from AI ... you need all the end markets, the end industries to adopt AI”  —  Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang pushed Europe to adopt artificial intelligence more quickly …

title: OpenAI says it will make its AI models available on Google Cloud's model garden and Antigravity coding tool in the coming weeks, after launching on AWS in April (Jordan Novet/CNBC)
summary:
Jordan Novet / CNBC:
OpenAI says it will make its AI models available on Google Cloud's model garden and Antigravity coding tool in the coming weeks, after launching on AWS in April  —  OpenAI will make its artificial intelligence models available for developers through Google's cloud, following years of competition between the two companies.
